title: 🖼️ Reference Curator

accepted_baseline.label: Pinterest clean search baseline + local preference memory

current_candidate.summary: Reference Curator exposed in visual launcher after preference-learning lab implementation.

open_feedback: This is central infrastructure, not a side gallery.
Learn WHY/FOR WHAT an image is preferred, not only like/dislike.
Use A/B comparisons for use-specific preference.
Track useful vs reference-only and descriptors such as brutalist, creepy, clean, scale, material.
Inspect real Pinterest metadata before claiming GIF/video support.
